items.titolo: ChatGPT-6 Astra cracks 85-year-old 1941 Enigma-coded message in two days
items.descrizione: A German Army Enigma transmission from 85 years ago, known as the MVUEH message, has been cracked by GTP-Astra in just two days.

items.titolo: Alibaba claims new Qwen Image 2.1 AI model beats Google Nano Banana 2.0 with minuscule 7B parameter model
